title: Newsroom newsletter panel: counts, lists, issues, approval, test send, delivery history
description: Administration panel backed by newsletter custom queries and mutations with group checks: subscriber counts, issues and actions (approve for a time, cancel, stop, test send to own address), delivery, bounce and complaint history, pause and resume, admin erasure and CSV export.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Newsroom Newsletter panel merged to develop in PR 544 (feat: newsroom newsletter panel). Operations: newsletterOverview, newsletterIssueDeliveries, newsletterSubscribers, newsletterExport, newsletterErase, newsletterResume. Counters on COUNT# rows with recount. pytest, test-plugins, tsx panel test and cucumber demo scenarios pass; CI green. Left open: not enabled/deployed on a site, no main promotion, and the subscriber scan gap noted in docs/newsletter.md.
